tasks.taskText: parseDuration in src/duration.mjs accepts hours ("h") and minutes ("m") but silently ignores a seconds part, so parseDuration("2m5s") returns 120 instead of 125 and parseDuration("5s") returns 0. Make it accept an "s" unit (whole seconds) alongside "h" and "m", in any order, so that "2m5s" is 125, "5s" is 5 and "1h0m30s" is 3630. Keep the existing behavior for hours and minutes and keep the function's documentation accurate. Do not change the tests under test/.

Add an exported function formatDuration(totalSeconds) to src/duration.mjs, the inverse of parseDuration: it takes a whole number of seconds and returns the compact text with hours, minutes and seconds in that order, omitting any part that is zero, so formatDuration(3665) is "1h1m5s", formatDuration(5400) is "1h30m", formatDuration(59) is "59s", and formatDuration(0) is "0s". parseDuration(formatDuration(n)) must equal n for every non-negative integer n. Do not change the tests under test/.
